preconditions.text: An L2 sequencer outage occurs, so the Chainlink feed data goes stale.; The stale quote still falls inside the configured heartbeat window (maxStaleness).; The Chainlink curator path has no L2 sequencer uptime gate or post-outage grace-period enforcement.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.
evidence: The absence of an L2 sequencer uptime gate in the Chainlink curator path will cause stale-price valuation for Covenant market users as a malicious trader will wait for a sequencer outage, let the feed go stale, and execute trades before the data refreshes.

In [src/curators/oracles/chainlink/ChainlinkOracle.sol:15](src/curators/oracles/chainlink/ChainlinkOracle.sol:15) the Chainlink adapter simply inherits Euler’s implementation, which only enforces `maxStaleness` against the feed heartbeat and never checks the L2 sequencer status. When combined with [src/curators/oracles/CrossAdapter.sol:52](src/curators/oracles/CrossAdapter.sol:52), which forwards quotes without additional gating, the router accepts quotes so long as they fall inside the configured heartbeat window—even if the sequencer is down and the data is no longer trustworthy. This design omission leaves the protocol blind to sequencer restarts and the recommended post-outage grace peri
- Only the heartbeat window is respected; there is no sequencer uptime feed check or grace-period enforcement.
